IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Wednesday, August 5, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with 32 calls and only 150 hands on book — Google and Meta data centers pulling heavy. Ermco's got 26 spots on the Google Moorsville gig (5-10s + Saturday work), while Meade Electric is hiring 15 JWs at **$53.80/hr** for Meta Lebanon on brutal 5-12s Mon-Fri plus 10-hour Saturdays with 10% over-scale kicker. This is the kind of relentless schedule that thins boards fast.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** shows serious money if you can stomach the grind. Prime Controls has 56 opens on Micron ID1 at **$45.33/hr** base but adds **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) plus **$20/hr travel premium** — that math works out to real coin on a PLA job. VECA's got META work at true scale **$65.33/hr** with incentive OT premiums, the sweet spot if you want top dollar without data center slavery hours.

**LU-1105 Newark, OH** is slinging premium OT: Superior Group's pulling 13 on Vantage and 11 on Conesville (4-10s + 2-8s) with **all OT double time**. That's the structure that makes six-figure summers happen. ESI's running **$2.01 over scale** day shift on Project NAB/NAH.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** (35 calls, 201 hands) — Cupertino, Pieper, Gurtz, and MJ are all stacked on Port Washington Data Center. **JW wage plus $10/hr** premium, but running 50-60 hour weeks (some 60s). Wisconsin hands know this contractor pool. Drug test required.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** holds 55 calls across four contractors. Inglett & Stubbs alone has 63 spots split between QTS Fayette and Wellstar Paulding Hospital at **$40/hr** — comfortable scale, reasonable hours, lower cost of living. Not glamorous, but steady work.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** (22 calls, 102 hands) is aggressive: Parsons Electric hitting 60 JWs on Polaris Forge at **$44.80/hr** base plus **$100/day non-taxed per diem**, **$100–$150/day incentive** (weekends bump to $150), and **another $100/day** if you pull ND license. That's **$544.80/day** walking money on a 10-hour shift. Six-10s, but the board's thin and work's real.

**The move:** Data centers and PLA projects are vacuuming up hands nationwide — 1083 open calls across 165 locals means boards are bleeding out. Chase the premiums (Wisconsin's $10/hr bump, Boise's travel money, Newark's double-time OT structure) or chase the grind (Indianapolis, Grand Forks) where supply's tight and desperation pays.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Wednesday, August 5, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and roughly 140 hands needed — the board's deepest bench. New River Electric has 40 JL slots on distribution work, **$125/night per diem plus a $125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s with a CDL requirement. Another 9 JL calls out to Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional weekend shifts, same per diem. Capital Electric is splicing cable in Johnstown (6 JL, OSHA 10 and Class A CDL required). This is volume work — steady, regional, and moving.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 22 calls chasing 102 hands into the Polaris Forge data center near Harwood. Parsons Electric dominates with 60 inside JW slots at **$44.80/hr**, **non-taxed $100/day per diem**, and **incentive pay ranging $100–$150/day** depending on day of week. Six 10-hour days, all OT premium. Hunt Electric and Northern Valley are filling air base work at the same scale with 4-10s and Friday OT premiums.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** shows 20 calls across 133 hands. Prime Controls has 56 inside JW at the Micron fab paying **$45.33/hr** with **$20/hr travel pay plus $170/day lodging** (PLA job, date TBD). VECA's META fab work mirrors that rate; their Micron call matches. This is semiconductor infrastructure — high volume, stable duration, locked pay scales.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** is thin on calls (47 total, only 62 hands) but tells the real story: pay scales are weak across the board — nothing above **$66/hr**, and most slots are non-union classification work (laborers, mechanics, groundmen). Tree work tops out at **$43.55/hr**. The Alaska board is hungry but offering less.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** has 9 calls but solid rates. Summit and Cupertino are both at **$55/hr** (NM JIW license and OSHA 10 required), **all OT double time**. Rosendin's **$40/hr base + $15 incentive** is the outlier.

Data-center and transmission work is consolidating the board — Grand Forks, Boise, and Columbus are pulling hands toward 10-week industrial pushes with locked incentives and non-taxed per diem.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Wednesday, August 5, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is moving serious volume with 21 calls across 30 hands — the deepest board today. Charter Mechanical's Intel Ronler Acres gig (Hillsboro) is pulling 4 orbital welders for tool install work; PermaCold's got 3 refrigeration service calls in Portland Metro; and Apollo Mechanical is staffing BIM detailers at foreman scale on the Tigard Intel site. High-spec semiconductor and data center work is the play here — if you bend tube and read prints, this board clears fast.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running 18 calls, 61 hands deep — BCS Mechanical's Sego Project (West Valley) needs 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 journeyman plumbers on 4-10s starting Aug 3, with full OT. DSI's QTS facility in Eagle Mountain adds 6 more pipefitters on a mixed 5-10 / 1-8 rotation. This is volume work: straight days, predictable hours, established contractors. Book 1 will clear inside a week.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 13 calls, 31 hands — Apollo's DC2 Data Center project (Aurora) is the headline, running 6-10s commercial rate plus incentive for fitters. US Eng. Metalworks (Shop) and their Broadcom Fort Collins high-purity tube-bending call offer 10% over contract. Murphy's Corden Pharma gig (Boulder) pays **$125 per diem** if you're outside 100 miles, combo welders, 2nd shift 5-10s. Technical skills (SS fittings, tube work, high-purity) command premium.

**LU-213 St John, NB** has 9 calls, 22 hands — Irving Oil Refinery and Irving Pulp & Paper are running simultaneous day-shift hirings through CAM and Stuart Olson. Journeyman pipefitters, day shift 7:30 AM starts, industrial-scale refinery and mill work. Short-term GPMA agreement slots available.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** — thin board (2 calls, 6 hands) but solid: PMI's got Ellsworth AFB (Box Elder, SD) and Fort Meade VA Hospital (Sturgis, SD) openings. **$100 per diem daily**, OSHA 10 mandatory, background checks required. Plumbers and combo welders.

Semiconductor fab and data center work is vacuum-sealing these boards; industrial process piping (refineries, mills) is the backup draw for short-term commitments.
